    """
    🧠 ADHD/Autism-optimized task management with love
    💝 Designed to work WITH neurodivergent brains, not against them
    """
    # 🌟 Honor the beautiful neurodivergent mind
    blessed_tasks = []

    for task in tasks:
        if task.complexity <= energy_level and task.duration <= attention_span:
            # ✨ This task aligns with current capacity - beautiful!
            task.add_blessing("Perfect fit for your amazing brain!")
            blessed_tasks.append(task)
        else:

            blessed_tasks.extend(micro_tasks)

    return blessed_tasks  # 🚀 Ready for neurodivergent excellence!
